tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_6.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
stats = g.agg(['mean','std','max','count'])
# z-score of each row within its group
df['mean'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('mean')
df['std'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('std')
df['z'] = (df['BilledCost'] - df['mean']) / df['std']
top = df.nlargest(10, 'z')[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','mean','std','z']]
print(top.to_string())
